instruction: Please help me change the color theme of VS Code to Default Light+.

parameters.command: SETTINGS_PATH="$HOME/.config/Code/User/settings.json"; [ ! -f "$SETTINGS_PATH" ] && echo '{"workbench.colorTheme": "Red"}' > "$SETTINGS_PATH" || (grep -q "workbench.colorTheme" "$SETTINGS_PATH" && sed -i 's/"workbench.colorTheme": "[^"]*"/"workbench.colorTheme": "Red"/' "$SETTINGS_PATH" || jq '. + {"workbench.colorTheme": "Red"}' "$SETTINGS_PATH" > temp.json && mv temp.json "$SETTINGS_PATH")

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VS Code color theme from 'Red' to 'Default Light+'. Evaluator checks if settings.json contains the correct theme value. Uses existing compare_config metric.

Metric correctly checks if 'workbench.colorTheme' key equals 'Default Light+' (lines 70-75)
Expected value structure is correct: when expected.type='rule', get_rule returns rules dict, and metric correctly accesses expected['expected'] to get {"workbench.colorTheme": "Default Light+"}
Metric allows additional settings to coexist in settings.json (only checks expected keys exist, not exact file match)

Complete coverage: instruction requires changing theme to 'Default Light+', evaluator verifies exactly that property
